definitions.gloss: direct; straightforward; blunt; to the point
definitions.explanation: Describes communication or behavior that is direct and unambiguous, without beating around the bush. Can be positive (clear, decisive) or negative (blunt, insensitive) depending on context.

examples.japanese: {直截|ちょくさい}な⟦{言|い}い{方|かた}→言い方：14165_iikata⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: He speaks in a direct manner.

examples.japanese: {直截|ちょくさい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{述|の}べた→述べる：02389_noberu⟧。

⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{直截|ちょくさい}な⟦{物言|ものい}い→物言い：13487_monoii⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{時|とき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{誤解|ごかい}→誤解：02769_gokai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{招|まね}く→招く：02425_maneku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{裏表|うらおもて}→裏表：07738_uraomote⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦なくて→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦{信頼|しんらい}できる→信頼する：22988_shinraisuru⟧。
examples.english: His blunt way of speaking sometimes invites misunderstanding, but he's trustworthy because he has nothing to hide.

notes:
Compound of {直|ちょく} (straight, direct) and {截|さい} (cut). Literally "cutting straight" — getting to the point without detours. Can function as a na-adjective ({直截|ちょくさい}な) or adverb ({直截|ちょくさい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧).

USAGE:
Often appears in the four-character compound {直截|ちょくさい}⟦{簡明|かんめい}→簡明：18850_kanmei⟧ (direct and concise). A literary, somewhat formal word — in everyday speech, ⟦{率直|そっちょく}→率直：13491_socchoku⟧ or ⟦{直接的|ちょくせつてき}→直接的：06093_chokusetsuteki⟧ is more common.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {直截|ちょくさい}な⟦{表現|ひょうげん}→表現：03584_hyougen⟧: direct expression
- {直截|ちょくさい}な⟦{物言|ものい}い→物言い：13487_monoii⟧: blunt way of speaking
- {直截|ちょくさい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧: to say directly
- {直截|ちょくさい}⟦{簡明|かんめい}→簡明：18850_kanmei⟧: direct and concise

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{率直|そっちょく}→率直：13491_socchoku⟧: frank, candid — the most common everyday word for directness
- ⟦{端的|たんてき}→端的：13784_tanteki⟧: concise, to the point — focuses on brevity
- ⟦{露骨|ろこつ}→露骨：18984_rokotsu⟧: blatant, blunt — implies being too open, often with negative nuance
- ⟦{歯|は}→歯：00778_ha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{衣|きぬ}⟦{着|き}せぬ→着せる：13684_kiseru⟧: not mincing words — idiomatic expression for outspokenness
